decisions.reason: The marine box cooler line holds a major market share in water cooling systems and is a core part of the firm's marine offering.
The marine cooling unit complements the box cooler line and supports the marine lifecycle business, though no website evidence since 2018 adds some uncertainty.
Compact oil coolers build on established competence and serve recurring transportation and industrial demand.
Finned tubes are an essential component of the firm's air coolers and support its own exchanger production.
Enhanced tubes reflect the firm's R&D strength and support its efficiency and sustainability promise.
